fact: L'Express reports that the Ministry of ICT (MITCI), with the Data Protection Office, officially launched the Mauritius National Data Strategy 2025-2029 ('A New Era of Trust') at Ebene on 28 January 2026, setting the country's long-term vision for responsible data governance and strategic use of data.

Minister of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation Avinash Ramtohul spoke on 16 July 2026 of the government's commitment to digital governance through the implementation of a National Data Governance Strategy, presenting it as in implementation; the document gives no approval or launch date.
Minister Ramtohul said the National Data Strategy (2025-2029) guides Government, people and businesses on how to handle and process data.
The Minister said the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner has finalised a national data strategy on data sharing, governance and protection, with no adoption stated.
